title: Chapter 187 Entering The Underground Palace
content:
Chapter 187 Entering The Underground Palace

"No matter what, the death energy has appeared in our territory. We cannot turn a blind eye. We must send people in to find out the situation." Wang Shuo said decisively.

Afterwards, everyone discussed the current situation of the territory's population, buildings, etc.

Wang Shuo looked at the current public sentiment and found that the average had dropped to 77 points. This was a major event that could not be ignored.

If you want to upgrade your territory, you need at least 80 popular support points.

Wang Shuo told Duan Wenxi and Suo Yong to step up the construction of residential houses so that the residents have something to do and integrate into the big family of Wana Village as soon as possible.

"Artisan Camp, what's the situation now?"

Suo Yong quickly replied: "There are currently more than 240 people in the craftsman camp. In addition to the previous occupations, there are also new occupations such as gardeners, stonemasons, and bamboo masons. It is a prosperous scene, and everyone is contributing their own efforts to the construction of the territory. strength."

Wang Shuo nodded and asked: "How is the current military construction going?"

"Back to the lord, the Golden Fire Cavalry, the current average level is 24, a total of 100 people, on standby at any time."

"The city defense army has recruited 400 people so far, and training is being stepped up."

Since the establishment of the military camp, soldiers' daily training can also increase experience, but it is much slower than killing monsters.

"The Archer Camp currently has 400 people, with an average level of 17."

"The Ballista Battalion currently has more than 50 people, with an average level of 16."

"The Black Mountain Bandits, currently close to 200 people,..."

Wang Shuo was thoughtful when he saw everyone's reports.

The number of people continues to increase, and the average level is pulled down.

At the same time, he also noticed that the command ability of each military unit leader had not kept pace with the increase in numbers.

This means that these soldiers cannot be commanded flexibly on the battlefield.

Fengze Village was a lesson learned from the past. Wang Shuo discussed with everyone and decided to reorganize the army.

Wang Shuo remembered some of the previous army formations, so he decided: ten men per team, set up a team, and a hundred men per column, set up a centurion.

Ayub, Li Jianguo, Gong Kai, Gong Ping, and Bai Liliang respectively served as centurions.

Each person controls 100 people, and all excess troops are converted into reserves.

In this way, the level of the army can be improved, thus improving the combat effectiveness, and it can also arouse the warlike spirit of the army.

After all, as long as a reserve soldier wants to become a soldier, he will definitely want to become a regular soldier.

As for those who did not want to be soldiers, Wang Shuo allowed them to convert to civilian citizenship.

Organized like this.

There is another most important reason, that is, the command value of these people is only 10 points.

Wang Shuo's own command value was already close to 40 points.

Wang Shuo couldn't figure it out for a while. Could it be that because he was a lord, his command points increased faster?

In the battle with Fengze Village, the command value of Ayub and others did not increase, as if they had encountered a bottleneck.

Therefore, they currently command a maximum of 100 people.

After looking at the situation of several arms, Wang Shuo felt helpless.

Currently there are only cavalry and legion orders.

Other troops do not have legion orders and do not receive legion attribute bonuses.

Take your time!

After resting for a day, Wang Shuo felt that he could wait no longer.

In the central square, Wang Shuo gathered all the troops.

Order people to dig the passage to the Dragon King's underground palace.

Ten minutes later, the passage blocked by Wang Shuo was reopened.

I released a goat and tested it, but found nothing unusual.

Wang Shuo asked Gong Zheng to go in first.

The passage is narrow and it is not easy for large troops to pass through.

Therefore, Wang Shuo only allowed the first members of the Swift Scout Team to enter the passage.

After walking through dozens of meters of passage, the original gate of the Dragon King's Underground Palace appeared in front of us.

Near the gate, a faint aura of death lingered, making it look very ghostly.
